question: Can one rights-cleared same-plate three-scan set provide a mechanically valid scanner-repeat residual control without treating the historical plate, scanner, or scan settings as film-stock truth?

source.title: Precise Photometric Measurements from a 1903 Photographic Plate Using a Commercial Scanner
source.observed_description: f0007.tif, f0008.tif and f0009.tif are repeated scans at focus +1.4 of the same 2.4 by 2.4 inch central plate area, reported as 3840 pixels.

allowed_actions_after_source_pass: fit only per-scan affine intensity normalization on development regions
measure registered repeat residual variance, NPS, ACF and row-column structure
compare the residual with the existing P6A independent shot-plus-read noise family
retain a scanner-nuisance stress profile or close as unidentified
forbidden: infer or backfill film stock, emulsion, exposure, development, scanner, illuminant or profile metadata
treat fixed plate grain as scanner noise
treat repeat residual as emulsion grain
claim scanner calibration or population transfer
modify completed P6A-P6K gates or results
download the full 3.6GB record under this contract
claim_ceiling: CC-BY-4.0 same-plate same-workflow scanner-repeat nuisance evidence only; not film stock, emulsion grain, scanner calibration, colour response, product or population evidence.
